item.title: Playing with Elixir is just FUN
item.description: Playing with Elixir is just FUN I’ve been using Elixir for a few weeks now, and I have to say - it really lives up to the hype. The functional programming paradigms, the actor model with OTP, and the fault-tolerant design make it a joy to work with. What Makes Elixir Special Pattern Matching: One of the most elegant features. Instead of complex conditionals, you can pattern match directly in function definitions:
